name: Just Yuri
source:
What if Act III of the original game starred Yuri, but no blood had to be spilled to get the two of you together?

In Just Yuri, you can finally spend some quality time with the Lavendar Lass you've come to love so dearly. She'll open up to you, you'll open up to her, you'll play some Tetris together, and even encounter a number of surprises along the way!

Take care of Yuri, and she'll take care of you. And if you don't take care of her... well let's just say she won't take it lying down.

[From [url=https://dokimods.me/mods/just-yuri]DokiMods[/url]]
